scene: Unrolling the miniature scroll reveals departure gates to three vibrant city districts.
picture: Side-view station concourse. On the far left, a yellow streetcar awaits passengers. Left of centre, the grandfather in his navy apron stands holding his bicycle with its plant crate, examining a small scroll. Centre right, an elevated track up high holds a vine-covered tram. On the right, a painted koi boat floats beside a wooden dock.
shown: a yellow vintage streetcar idling with open folding doors on the far left
a carved wooden koi-shaped boat moored at a canal dock on the right
a glass-topped tram adorned with vines waiting on tracks up high
